decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 27 Q1). G0 instruments before verdicts: the committed switchboard scenarios artifact must reproduce parsed-equal with the seam in the module (always), and at the committed budget the committed N3 full_fleet welfare must reproduce exactly - any mismatch raises. G2 the consumer FIRES under its condition on a nonzero fraction of live ticks, else withhold. G3 the D6 rule verbatim at the documented 5% bar, consumer condition vs the incumbent full_fleet condition on the same harness, seeds and budgets: adopt_into_default_candidate at >= +5% (eligibility only - a decision record and package work would still follow), refuse_as_consumer at <= -5%, eligible_not_promoted between (the seam works and stays opt-in). The beg interaction is measured and recorded beside the verdict, never gated here. Nothing deletes or weakens the incumbent rule.
decision.pre_run_prediction: Written before the run: eligible_not_promoted. D6 measured the decision seam's welfare as near-saturated (the attentive keeper dominates welfare and fleet-vs-frozen sits at ~1%), so the consumer's end-to-end welfare delta is expected inside the +-5% band even though its recommendation quality beats the incumbent rule by 44.685% per tick. The consumer is expected to FIRE on a real fraction of mid-to-late-life ticks (warm buckets accumulate with age), and the beg interaction is expected to move only marginally. A welfare delta clearing the bar in either direction refutes this and ships as the finding.
